messages:
taylor: Quick PSA — security completed a docs audit and flagged a number of public examples that include hard-coded API keys or plaintext credential snippets. We need to remove those and replace with env-var examples. Audit report: https://github.com/redwood-inference/security/issues/221

leon: Ack. Do we have a policy for inline examples vs. gist snippets?

taylor: Yes
policy summary: No runnable example should contain real credentials or long-lived tokens. Use placeholders and recommend RW_API_KEY (env) + short-lived session tokens where possible. We're also listing a recommended rotation cadence (90 days) and guidance to use KMS/HSM for production keys. Full policy doc in the PR.

anya: Timeline? Some of these examples are used in onboarding slides and quickstarts.

security-bot: Policy approved by InfoSec on 2026-03-20. Enforcement window: 14-day remediation for public docs; 60-day remediation for open-source example repos owned by teams. Violations after windows will trigger takedown request for public-facing assets.

leon: I'll run a repo grep and open a cleanup PR for SDK examples. Quick plan: replace any `api_key = "sk_live_..."` with `api_key = os.environ.get("RW_API_KEY")` and add one-liner instructions to set env var.

ci-bot: Automated scan found 12 matches in `examples/` and 3 matches in `docs/quickstarts/`. See CI report: https://ci.internal.redwood/reports/docs-audit/1764123456

taylor: Example replacement snippet to use in PRs: 
```
# bad (do NOT ship)
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="sk_live_XXXXXXXX")

# good (recommended)
import os
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ.get("RW_API_KEY"))
```

anya: For onboarding decks we can keep a mocked example but must explicitly label the token as "EXAMPLE ONLY" and show how to create an API key in the Console. I'll update the slide deck and ping learning.

leon: Also found several JS snippets in community repos. I'll coordinate with eng owners to cut PRs. We should also add a linter rule in the docs CI to fail on regex matches for `sk_live_` or `REDWOOD_API` patterns.

security-bot: Recommendation accepted: add a CI lint that fails on credential-like literals. We will provide the regex and allowlists for test fixtures.

docs-bot: I opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/501 that updates quickstarts, replaces inline creds, and adds an "Examples security" note. Staged for review and deploy. CDN purge scheduled after merge.

leon: Action item for SDK team: create a small compatibility snippet for local dev that shows using `.env` with dotenv and a clear warning not to commit that file. e.g.: 
```
# .env (local dev only)
RW_API_KEY=sk_test_xxx
```
and add `.env` to .gitignore in examples repos.

anya: Comm plan: I'll prepare a one-paragraph customer note (what changed, why, do I need to act?) and a pinned community post linking the migration guide and security FAQ. Draft will be ready EOD.

taylor: Ops note: Any customer-facing SDK changes? No. This is docs and example hygiene + policy. But let's include an FAQ entry for "Why did you remove the key from my example?" explaining safety and how to configure env vars and rotation.

ci-bot: Tests queued: docs lint + secret-scan. Expected merge window: 2026-03-22 18:00 UTC.

security-bot: Owners please ensure any CI fixture keys are stored in vault and mirrored via CI secrets; do not check them into repo history. We'll run a historical scan for leaked keys and notify owners separately.

leon: Will open PRs for all matches today and add the docs CI lint. I'll tag eng owners in each PR.

anya: Will send customer note and community pin; will coordinate with @sarah for any targeted emails to high-usage customers who might rely on our quickstarts.

docs-bot: Merge ready: /sdk/quickstarts cleanup + examples sanitization. Preview site updated at https://staging.docs.redwood/sanitized-examples

taylor: Thanks all. Summary / action items: 1) leon: PRs to remove inline creds and add .gitignore + dotenv snippet; 2) anya: customer note + community pin; 3) docs team: enable secret-lint in docs CI and merge PR #501; 4) security: run historical leak scan and notify owners. We'll reconvene in 48 hours if anything blocks. :lock:
